ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits_summary: Full reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable tuition fees plus an academic allowance of ₹2,500 to ₹13,500 per year for Scheduled Caste students studying in Class 11 through PhD.
exclusions: Students belonging to categories other than Scheduled Caste
documents_required: Previous Year Marksheet and Fee Receipt
application_steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) and fill out the Post-Matric Scholarship application.
Upload Caste and Income certificates for institute verification.
